sql: SELECT kind, coalesce(detail_json->>'channel','') AS channel,       CASE WHEN at < '2026-09-16T14:45:00Z' THEN 'pre-fix' ELSE 'post-fix' END AS era,       count(*) AS n, min(at)::text AS first, max(at)::text AS last,       left(string_agg(DISTINCT coalesce(detail,''), ' | '), 300) AS details FROM execution_collector_events WHERE at >= now() - interval '24 hours'   AND kind IN ('seq_gap','snapshot_requested','disconnected','loop_error','book_invalid','ws_error','thread_started','thread_stopped') GROUP BY 1,2,3 ORDER BY 1,3,2
